purpose: Diagnose the mechanical origin of the highly concentrated v094c catalogue-candidate yield before any candidate-level adjudication or registration. Replay the frozen v094c mechanical funnel using frozen local source caches, but retain only aggregate/per-triplet counters and population-level recurrence diagnostics.

allowed_reads.v094c_candidate_csv: aggregate streaming only; candidate coordinates/source IDs may be held transiently in memory for population-level statistics but must never be emitted
allowed_reads.v094c_frozen_runner_and_parent_inputs: allowed to reconstruct exact mechanical selection and funnel semantics
allowed_reads.v094d_legacy_timing_impact_csv: allowed only to stratify legacy triplets by timing class and num_sub status
allowed_reads.v094d_master_registry: provenance hash only; no candidate linkage or candidate inspection

prospective_questions: Is the v094c yield concentration still extreme after normalising by positive-plate representative source count?
At which frozen mechanical gate does the 251-300 concentration emerge: common coverage, control mismatch, or independent confirmation?
Is the output dominated by a small number of triplets, canonical pairs, positive plates, independent plates, or control plates?
How much of the output is recurrent/duplicated at the catalogue-position or source-signature level?
Is there evidence of pile-up near the 3 arcsec confirmation boundary, the 5 arcsec independent boundary, or immediately beyond the 5 arcsec control-mismatch boundary?
Are single-scan versus multi-scan support classes associated with strongly different aggregate yields?
Do the three v094d timing-invalid legacy triplets or the multi-subexposure strata contribute disproportionately to v094c yield?
Is the concentration primarily order-local, sky/field-local, or plate/pair-local?

frozen_mechanical_semantics.common_coverage_required: candidate position covered by at least one valid scan of positive, independent, and control plates
frozen_mechanical_semantics.multiscan_representatives: exact v094c mutual-nearest-neighbour <=5 arcsec representative construction
frozen_mechanical_semantics.zero_source_triplets: retain as provenance holds and exclude from mechanical replay exactly as v094c

mechanical_reproduction: exact 21 zero-source holds and 763 mechanically matchable triplets
per-triplet candidate-row reproduction against frozen v094c CSV
global reproduction of key v094c mechanical counters
concentration: triplet, canonical-pair, positive-plate, independent-plate, and control-plate concentration
recurrence: global nearest-neighbour separation fractions without emitting coordinates
positive/independent/source-pair signature reuse distributions without emitting source IDs
threshold_sensitivity: independent separation cumulative counts at prospectively fixed thresholds
control-nearest separation bins and survival counts at prospectively fixed thresholds
required_diagnostics.spatial_aggregate: coarse equal-area sky-bin counts only; no candidate coordinates emitted

interpretive_boundary: This audit diagnoses mechanical/pathological concentration in the exploratory v094c screen. It does not validate a transient, construct corrected Branch A/B/C science populations, establish catalogue absence, or justify registration.
next_stop: Interpret aggregate pathology findings before any candidate-level inspection or registration.
